name: Students and families
h1: One roster for students and families.
sub: Students, guardians and ensembles together, with portals that answer parents' questions before they reach your inbox.
get: Each student profile holds guardians, ensembles, instrument, section and uniform sizes.
Parents see balances, forms and announcements for every child they're linked to. Students see their own balance, assignments and music.
At the end of the year, rollover promotes grades, archives graduates and carries balances forward, with a record of every change.

faq.a: You do, from inside Program Partner. Families join with the code you give them.

faq.q: What happens to a student who leaves?
faq.a: Archive them. Their logins close, their history stays, and you can bring them back.
No. It never deletes a student or erases a balance.

steps.body: Import your roster from a spreadsheet, or send it to us and we can import it for you.
